name: Freedom Mortgage
notes: Researched from public freedommortgage.com pages only. Sign in with email address and password; registration needs the 10-digit loan number, SSN, email and a password. Online/app one-time or recurring payments from a bank account set up in the account; same-day cutoff 10:59 p.m. ET; 24/7 automated phone line 855-690-5900; mail addresses by state (Chicago or Pasadena). Credit cards are explicitly not accepted. Recurring payments should be set up 5 business days before the due date; cancellation any time, but the draft is sent to the bank 3 days before, so late cancellations take effect after that draft. Grace period 15 calendar days (received by end of the 16th day). No fees listed, so none modelled. Payoff statements online/app or by mail. Hardship: repayment, forbearance, modification, short sale, deed-in-lieu, HAF via 855-690-5900. Paperless steps not documented publicly (family default kept).

pay_online.note: Bank account only: credit cards are not accepted.

autopay_cancel.note: Drafts are sent to the bank 3 days early; a cancellation inside that window takes effect after the next draft.

help.title: How to make a payment
paragraphs: Online or in the mobile app, add your bank account first, then make a one-time or recurring payment. Payments submitted by 10:59 p.m. ET are credited that day and can take 1 to 2 business days to appear in your transaction history. Credit cards are not accepted.

By phone, call 855-690-5900 for the 24/7 automated system (agents Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET, Saturday 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. ET) with your routing and account numbers. By mail, send checks to P.O. Box 6656, Chicago, IL 60680-6656, or if your property is in AZ, AK, CA, CO, HI, ID, MT, NV, NM, OR, WA, WY or UT, to P.O. Box 7230, Pasadena, CA 91109-7230.

help.title: Set up or cancel recurring payments
paragraphs: Set up recurring payments at least five business days before your next due date, or the first one may not draft in time.

You can cancel recurring payments at any time, but each draft is sent to your bank three days before its scheduled date. If you cancel inside that window, the cancellation takes effect after that payment completes.

help.title: When is my payment considered late?
paragraphs: You have a grace period of 15 calendar days after your due date. To avoid a late fee, your payment must be received by the end of the 16th day after the due date.
Mailed payments are credited on the date they are received, not the postmark date.

help.title: Create your online account
paragraphs: To register you need your 10-digit Freedom Mortgage loan number, your Social Security number, an email address and a strong password. If your loan just transferred to Freedom Mortgage, your new loan number is in your welcome letter.
You sign in with your email address and password; separate links help if you forgot either one.

help.title: Help with mortgage payments
paragraphs: Options to stay in your home include repayment plans, forbearance and loan modification; a short sale or deed-in-lieu can help you leave without foreclosure. The federal Homeowner Assistance Fund may also help.
Start by logging in or calling 855-690-5900. You may be asked for IRS Form 4506-T, a financial report, a hardship letter and proof of income.

extra.intent: Using the Freedom Mortgage website help pages, find the latest time an online payment can be submitted and still be credited the same day. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

A borrower asks whether they can pay their Freedom Mortgage payment with a credit card. Using the website help pages, answer yes or no and say how they can pay instead. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No, credit cards are not accepted; pay from a bank account online, by phone or by check.
